text: My Help Comes from YahwehA Song of Ascents.I will lift up my eyes to the mountains;From where shall my help come?
My help comes from Yahweh,Who made heaven and earth.
He will not allow your foot to stumble;He who keeps you will not slumber.
Behold, He who keeps IsraelWill not slumber and will not sleep.
Yahweh is your keeper;Yahweh is your shade on your right hand.
The sun will not strike you by day,Nor the moon by night.
Yahweh will keep you from all evil;He will keep your soul.
Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming inFrom now until forever.
